trends.headline: Astroparticle physicist Matthew Szydagis on UAP science | Reality Check
trends.summary: Ross Coulthart and astroparticle physicist Matthew Szydagis talk about the UAP Science Advisory Council, declassification requests, testing of Art's Parts samples and who has been harassing Szydagis.

trends.headline: Ross Coulthart Q&A: Coulthart: New whistleblower rules are 'not transparency'
trends.summary: In this week's episode, Coulthart tackles questions about why there is still no official government platform for ordinary Americans to report UAP sightings, whether DMT could ever be used as a legitimate research tool at Skinwalker Ranch, and the ongoing speculation around a major UAP-related event in 2027.

trends.headline: UFO files: Avi Loeb puzzled by unusual objects in sightings being soundless
trends.summary: Loeb was puzzled by the latest batch of files acknowledging the objects were moving at super-high speed, but making no sound.

trends.headline: Ross Coulthart: 75 years later, we're still asking the same UFO questions
trends.summary: Coulthart and fellow UFO expert Luis Elizondo were unimpressed by the latest release of files by the Pentagon Friday morning.
